tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
- The recorded browser session demonstrates logging into Magento admin, opening the Customers grid, applying filters (Name, Email, Group, Website), exporting results, selecting a customer row, choosing a mass-action (Assign a Customer Group), submitting it, opening the customer's Edit page, changing Last Name, and saving.

Task Definition:
- Purpose: create a deterministic, re-usable tool that navigates to the Magento admin Customers grid, applies optional filters, performs an export, selects a specified customer by ID, performs the mass-action 'Assign a Customer Group' with a given target group, opens that customer's edit page, updates Last Name and saves. The tool follows the recorded interaction order and uses recorded stable element identifiers where available.

Action Plan (detailed):
1. Navigate to the provided customers grid URL.
2. Confirm grid presence (extract_page_content).
3. Populate filters (Name, Email, Group, Website) using stable element hashes discovered during recording.
4. Click Search and wait for grid refresh.
5. Choose export format and click Export to trigger download.
6. Select the specific customer row by its checkbox using a parameterized selector (input[value='{select_customer_id}']).
7. Choose the Actions dropdown option 'Assign a Customer Group' and set the group to the provided assign_group visible label.
8. Click Submit to apply the mass action and wait for refresh.
9. Click the Edit link for the selected customer by matching href pattern containing '/customer/edit/id/{select_customer_id}/'.
10. On the Edit page, update the Last Name field (recorded stable elementHash) with the provided new_last_name.
11. Click Save Customer and confirm the change using page extraction.

Variable Identification (inputs required):
- base_url: exact admin customers index URL used for navigation (e.g. recorded value http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/). Required to reach the correct admin page.
- filter_name: optional text used in the Name filter.
- filter_email: optional text used in the Email filter.
- filter_group: optional visible group label to filter the grid (e.g. 'Wholesale').
- filter_website: optional visible website label to filter (e.g. 'Main Website').
- export_format: export format selection (CSV/Excel/XML) — recorded export used CSV; tool parameterized for reuse.
- select_customer_id: the numeric customer id to be selected and edited (value attribute of checkbox) — required to deterministically target the correct row.
- mass_action: visible label of the Actions dropdown option to pick (tool demo uses 'Assign a Customer Group').
- assign_group: visible target group label to set when performing the assign-group mass action (e.g. 'General').
- new_last_name: new last name to write into the customer's Account Information (this demonstrates the edit flow).

Step Optimization / Selector choices:
- Prefer recorded elementHash values when the browser session captured them (these are deterministic for the exact demo DOM). Steps use the elementHash for filters, export controls, mass-action select, mass-action submit button, and Save button.
- For row-level selection and Edit link navigation we use parameterized CSS selectors that locate the checkbox/input by value='{select_customer_id}' and the Edit link by href containing '/customer/edit/id/{select_customer_id}/'. These are robust across pages and do not rely on drivers supporting :has/:contains.
- Inserted short wait() steps after filter/search/export/mass-action/save to allow the grid/page to refresh (the recording showed small delays and loading indicators). These waits are deterministic and minimal (1-2s) to stabilize automation.
- No conditional branching: the tool follows a single, deterministic flow that matches the recorded demo. It will perform each step in sequence using provided inputs. If optional filters (name/email/group/website) are empty strings the inputs will be set to empty and the Search will run against the broader grid.

Notes and caveats:
- The agent executing this tool must already be authenticated in the admin session (recording included prior login) — the tool does not perform authentication.
- Magento admin UI often requires JavaScript for full dynamic behavior; the recorded session included a "JavaScript seems to be disabled" notice but the demo interactions still succeeded. For robust automation, ensure JS is enabled in the browser context where this tool runs.
- CSRF/form_key protections: mass-action POSTs and edit saves may require a current form_key; clicking elements in-browser preserves session/formkey context. The tool intentionally clicks UI elements instead of constructing direct POSTs to avoid missing session tokens.
- Element hashes used are those captured during the recorded session and are included to provide deterministic interactions. If the target Magento instance has different DOM (extensions/theme changes), some selectors may need adjustment — the tool includes robust CSS/XPath patterns in the analysis to guide updates.

This tool implements the essential interactions from the recorded browser session and exposes the necessary parameters to re-run the same demo with different filter values, export format, target customer id, mass-action target group and an edit to the customer's Last Name.
name: magento_admin_customer_search_and_edit
description: Automates a deterministic demo of Magento 1 admin customer management: navigate to the Customers grid, apply filters, export results, select a customer, perform a mass-action (assign group), open the customer's Edit page, change Last Name and save. Uses the stable selectors and element hashes recorded during the browser session.

steps.description: Navigate to the Magento Admin Customers grid page (starting point for all actions).
Capture the initial grid state to confirm controls exist (filters, Search, Export, Actions).
steps.goal: Ensure the Customers grid and filter controls are present and visible before interacting

steps.description: Fill the Name filter input in the grid's filter row with the provided filter_name (empty string allowed).
Fill the Email filter input in the grid's filter row with the provided filter_email (empty string allowed).
Set the Group filter dropdown to the provided visible group label (if provided).
Set the Website filter dropdown to the provided visible website label (if provided).
Click the Search button to apply filters and load the filtered grid rows.
Wait for the grid to update after applying filters (allow pagination/ajax to settle).
Choose the requested Export format from the Export dropdown (CSV/Excel/XML).
Click the Export button to request the export in the selected format (initiates download).
Select the customer row checkbox for the specified customer id (value attribute must equal {select_customer_id}).
Choose the mass-action visible option from the Actions dropdown (e.g., 'Assign a Customer Group').
When assigning group, set the Group dropdown (the mass-action target selector) to the provided visible label (e.g., 'General').
Click the Submit button to execute the selected mass-action for the selected row(s).
Wait for the grid to refresh after the mass-action submission.
Ensure grid URL context preserved before navigating to edit. (No-op navigation step used to ensure the session and context are stable.)
Open the Edit page for the selected customer by clicking the row's Edit link that contains the customer's id in the href.
Wait for the customer Edit page to load.
Extract page content to confirm the Account Information section and Last Name control exist and are editable.
steps.goal: Capture the Edit page to verify fields are present before editing

steps.description: Set the Last Name input on the customer's Account Information to the provided new_last_name.
Click the Save Customer button to persist the Last Name change.
Wait for the save action to complete and page to reload.
Extract the Edit page or resulting grid page content to provide confirmation that Last Name shows the updated value.
steps.goal: Verify that the customer's Last Name was updated and capture final state

input_schema.name: base_url
input_schema.description: Full admin Customers grid URL (must point to the customers index), e.g. "http://dockerized-magento.local/index.php/admin/customer/"

input_schema.name: filter_name
input_schema.description: Name filter text (exact or partial). Leave empty to not filter by name.

input_schema.name: filter_email
input_schema.description: Email filter text (exact or partial). Leave empty to not filter by email.

input_schema.name: filter_group
input_schema.description: Customer Group visible text to filter by (e.g., "Wholesale", "General"). Use the visible label as shown in admin.

input_schema.name: filter_website
input_schema.description: Website visible text to filter by (e.g., "Main Website", "Admin"). Use the visible label as shown in admin.

input_schema.name: export_format
input_schema.description: Export format to select from the grid export control. One of: CSV, Excel, XML.

input_schema.name: select_customer_id
input_schema.description: Customer ID to target for selection and editing (value attribute of the row checkbox, e.g. "209"). The tool will select this ID's checkbox and open its Edit page.

input_schema.name: mass_action
input_schema.description: Mass-action visible option to select from the Actions dropdown. Use the visible label (e.g. "Assign a Customer Group").

input_schema.name: assign_group
input_schema.description: Visible target group label to assign when using 'Assign a Customer Group' mass action (e.g. "General"). If mass_action is not 'Assign a Customer Group' this value will still be applied to the group selector.

input_schema.name: new_last_name
input_schema.description: New Last Name to write into the customer's Account Information (will replace the existing Last Name).
